needles: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square seamless tileable albedo texture for RTS conifer crowns, grass tufts and sedge meshes. One full-frame material of densely overlapping fine green pine needles and slender tapered living foliage fibers. Predominantly vertical alignment with natural small deviations, extremely fine lengthwise veins and subtle sage/olive variation. Needle width around 1/200 image width, lengths around 1/12 image height, continuous evenly dense coverage. Orthographic straight-on material scan style, stylized realism. Flat neutral diffuse illumination, no glossy highlights, no cast shadows, no directional lighting, no strong gradients. Seamless periodic edges both horizontally and vertically. No broad leaves, no branches, no trunks, no cones, no soil, no text, no border. Opaque, full frame; engine supplies illumination and recolors this detail for each biome.
foliage: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable diffuse/albedo texture for an RTS game's existing solid tree crowns and shrub meshes, square 1024x1024. Create one full-frame foliage material: densely overlapping small living broad leaves, varied natural orientations, fine branching veins, olive and sage leaf coloration, occasional subdued warm tips. Leaf sizes roughly 1/18 to 1/30 image width. Uniform distribution and fine readable detail. Physically plausible stylized-realistic foliage surface, viewed orthographically straight on. Flat neutral diffuse illumination, no directional lighting, no glossy highlights, minimal soft occlusion only between leaves. Seamless periodic edges in both directions. Entire image is foliage with no background, no trunk, no border, no labels, no objects, no perspective, no large bright/dark areas. Game shader will recolor and provide all dynamic lighting.
